messages:
alyssa_cs: Quick heads-up — we're seeing a webhook ingestion backlog in the onboarding pipeline causing progress stalls for ~12 tenants (mostly trial & SMB). Root cause looks like a downstream batching regression after yesterday's runtime tweak. I'm drafting customer comms and want CS alignment before we send.

mike_se: thanks for flagging. can you share the affected tenant list? curious if any are on active renewal cadence.

alyssa_cs: hitting the list now — will DM the list to @priya_dir_cs and @jordan_eng. early scan: 3 on renewal within 30 days, 2 high-touch trials.

jordan_eng: we're 1 engineer in on a hotfix for the batching logic, ETA ~90min for a patch to reduce backlog + a follow-up job to catch up queued webhooks. will post updates here once progress is visible.

sam_sre: put a temporary throttle on non-critical downstream jobs to free workers for onboarding ingest. this should buy us ~45-60m. monitoring dashboards updated: https://internal.redwood/boards/ingest-backlog

alyssa_cs: draft outbound to affected tenants below. please review — want to send in next 30m with transparent ETA + mitigation offer. (draft)

----------------
Subject: Brief outage affecting onboarding progress — short ETA & support offer

Hi {CustomerName},

We're reaching out because you may see delays in onboarding progress or delayed webhook deliveries while we resolve an internal processing backlog. Our engineers have identified the issue and are actively working on a fix. We expect normal flow to resume within 2 hours and are running a catch-up job to process queued items.

What we're doing: applying a patch and prioritizing onboarding traffic; monitoring until all queued items finish.

What we're offering: a one-time account credit and a 45-minute office-hours session with an onboarding engineer to verify setup and answer questions.

If you'd like a status ping once your queue is clear, reply to this message and we'll follow up.

Apologies for the disruption — we're on it.

Best,
Redwood Customer Success
----------------

priya_dir_cs: Looks good. please add explicit note that no data was lost, just delayed. and term 'account credit' -> specify '% credit or $X' — prefer $200 for affected SMBs, 10% for larger accounts.

alyssa_cs: updated draft applied. thanks @priya_dir_cs. will send tailored emails to the 12 tenants after eng confirms patch. cc: ticket created in Zendesk for each tenant: #CS-INGEST-<id>

jordan_eng: patch applied at 3519876670, initial catch-up started. backlog depth dropped ~60% in 12m. continuing to run catch-up until normal levels.

incident-bot: [alert] rolling patch deployment completed to 3 pods — health checks passing.

sam_sre: catch-up job still running. estimated time to clear for all tenants ~1h. recommend we schedule office-hours slot for tomorrow 14:00 PST for any tenant that requests live help.

alyssa_cs: sending first batch of outbound messages now to 6 highest-impact tenants. will follow up with the rest after catch-up completes. tagging renewal owners for the 3 renewals: @priya_dir_cs.

mike_se: flagging potential renewal risk for the 3 accounts — suggest proactive 1:1 outreach and optional expansion of the credit if they escalate. can CS team prepare a one-pager summarizing mitigation & timeline for execs?

alyssa_cs: yes — I'll assemble a short exec summary and queue it in the renewal tracker. also collecting customer feedback via short form: https://forms.redwood/onboard-incident-feedback

priya_dir_cs: thanks team. please add any replies you get into the shared thread. we'll reconvene in 45m for a status pulse and finalize credit amounts for each tenant.

alyssa_cs: noted — will post final status and list of cleared tenants when catch-up completes. :thumbsup:
